title: SongReady
description: Published by Catalogue on routing key song.ready once a song's processing_status first becomes READY (both lyrics_status and waveform_status are READY, or a song has no lyrics and waveform is READY). Consumed by Search so newly processable songs are discoverable. May be re-announced for the same song (duplicate delivery or crash recovery); consumers must be idempotent. PARTIAL songs are NOT published.

song_id.description: The song that is now fully processed and ready to play.
